author: anistark
title: Violet Hour
description: A pixel-art dusk over a mountain lake. The moon stands low between the peaks, clouds drift across a violet sky and light up from below, the lake mirrors all of it in broken dashes, and pines sway along the near shore. No evening is ever the same.
ogAlt: Violet Hour: a pixel-art mountain lake at dusk in violet and magenta, the moon low between the peaks and its light on the water, with dark pines in front
